steps.name: pulseaudio-sink-target-latency
steps.subject: PulseAudio sink: the hardware buffer size is the target latency, not the maximum
steps.description:
startStream() set maxlength to 1024 frames and left tlength to the server. A server whose sink
renders blocks larger than that (a tunnel sink renders whatever its remote may take) underruns the
stream on every block: 62 zero samples per 1024 through the Android tunnel. The size is now tlength,
with maxlength negotiated. Reproduced and checked with plasma/diagnostics/media-probes/pa-gap.py;
a server-side block limit does not cure it (docs/73).
